## 06/10/2026 14:57 — ChatHub

Partner, I checked the link. urlChatHubturn0view0 is interesting **specifically for the multi-AI workflow we have been discussing**.

Its central idea is:

> **One prompt → several AI models → answers side-by-side → compare/summarise.**

It currently advertises access to **20+ models** and the ability to run **up to 6 chatbots simultaneously**, alongside file uploads, web access, prompt libraries, chat search/history, and code preview. citeturn0search0turn0search1

That overlaps strongly with what you've been manually doing:

**You → ChatGPT → Claude → Perplexity/other AI → compare → challenge → consolidate**

ChatHub potentially turns part of that into:

**You → one prompt → [GPT | Claude | Gemini | others] → comparison**

There is an especially relevant detail: its browser extension says it can work in **three different ways** — use an existing logged-in AI account, use your own API keys, or use ChatHub's bundled AI subscription. citeturn0search9

So I **wouldn't immediately buy it**. The important question for you isn't simply *"Is ChatHub good?"* It is:

**Can ChatHub become the multi-AI challenge/verification layer in the Learn → Unlearn → Relearn system we were discussing earlier today, without losing the deep context, Git evidence, files, memory, and specialised capabilities you currently get by working directly with each AI?**

That is worth investigating properly. My initial position is **yes for comparison/challenge, probably no as the replacement for your individual ChatGPT/Claude workflows**.

Also, their current yearly-billed pricing page shows **Pro at $14.99/month equivalent** and **Unlimited at $24.99/month equivalent**; importantly, the plans differ in model-query quotas and credits despite the "Unlimited" name. citeturn0search1

If this link was sent because you're considering using it, **don't subscribe yet**. I think we should test whether this removes an actual bottleneck in *your* current three-AI process rather than merely giving you another AI interface. memcite
